notes: The verse's one hard call is *were these*, taken as a single added unit: the ASV's recasting makes the Hebrew's prepositional predicate the English subject, so no predicate morpheme is left to bear the copula (rule 20's supplied-verb boundary). The competing reading gives *were* to the לְ under rule 49, but that morpheme already holds the *of* the ASV wrote for it.
The suffix of מַחְלְקוֹתָם is unrepresented because the ASV writes its referent out as *of the sons of Aaron*, which answers to the לְ and the construct chain the Hebrew already writes.
